title: Why Websites Check Your Exact Battery Percentage

vo.en: Check your battery percentage right now.

visual.description: Macro close-up of a man's thumb tapping on a glowing smartphone screen battery indicator.

vo.en: Most websites aren't just looking at cookies. They're quietly querying a hidden tool called the Battery Status API.

visual.description: A dark server room with rows of machines and blinking blue led lights on networking equipment.

vo.en: This reads your exact charge level down to eight decimal places, creating a unique digital signature.

visual.description: Close up of an electronic digital display with rapidly changing green decimal numbers and gauges.

vo.en: But here is the creepy part: using a VPN or incognito mode will not stop this tracking.

visual.description: Silhouette of a man in a dark hoodie sitting in front of three glowing computer monitors in a dark room.

vo.en: Data brokers use these readings to help fingerprint your device across different browsers without your permission.

visual.description: Fast-scrolling green binary code and matrix-style data streams on a black background.

vo.en: By matching these micro-patterns, they link your private browsing sessions directly back to your real identity.

visual.description: Abstract 3D network of glowing lines and dots connecting to form a global map or node system.
